description: Owner, evidence, and missing-contract map for the dag-ml cutover and adjacent V1 ecosystem blockers.

policy.default_engine_flip_condition: All required_for_cutover blockers are ready or passed, every referenced required gate passes, coverage_meter.summary.fallback == 0, and default_engine_postflip is the only pre-flip expected failure.
policy.advisory_scope: Advisory blockers track V1 ecosystem readiness that should not by itself block the nirs4all DEFAULT_ENGINE cutover.

blockers.title: Cutover gate runner and contracts are self-validating
expected_evidence: drop-gates.n4a.json validates
readiness-matrix.n4a.json validates
runner can list gates and readiness from a plain ecosystem checkout
blockers.missing_contract: None for tooling; this row guards future edits to the cutover contracts.
blockers.next_owner_action: Keep this gate green whenever cutover docs or runner code changes.

blockers.title: Full Python reference fallback ledger is empty
expected_evidence: coverage_meter --check passes
coverage_meter.summary.fallback == 0
no remaining EXPECTED_FALLBACK entry relies on implicit legacy execution
blockers.missing_contract: Native parity is still missing for duplicate-branch stacking and by-source multi-source pipelines: branch_dup_three_way_merge_predictions, branch_dup_named_with_metamodel, branch_dup_merge_all, multi_source_by_source_branch_distinct_preproc, multi_source_per_source_models_stacking, and multi_source_sources_concat_then_rf.
blockers.next_owner_action: Consume W51, W53, and W54 contract decisions, then remove fallback entries only after strict parity passes.

blockers.title: Native .n4a export covers stacking replay without legacy bridge
expected_evidence: native .n4a bundle tests pass without xfailed stacking replay
base producer order and meta-feature construction are persisted
bundle prediction from raw X matches the Python reference path
blockers.missing_contract: Native results persist base and meta refit artifacts, but do not yet persist the replay graph and column-order manifest needed to build stacking meta-features from raw bundle input.
blockers.next_owner_action: Implement W52 after W51 fixes the dag-ml stacking OOF/refit semantics.

blockers.title: dag-ml stacking OOF/refit semantics match legacy sklearn behavior
expected_evidence: dag-ml exposes an explicit contract for incomplete OOF coverage
refit-skip or validation-coverage behavior is no longer implicit
dag-ml and dag-ml-data lockstep validation still passes
blockers.missing_contract: The current runtime rejects duplicate-branch stacking when OOF predictions do not cover the refit sample universe, while legacy may skip or tolerate that path depending on merge/model shape.
blockers.next_owner_action: Finish W51 and publish the contract artifact consumed by nirs4all.

blockers.title: By-source feature layout is stable across dag-ml-data and nirs4all
expected_evidence: source/block order is serialized in a shared contract artifact
nirs4all by-source parity probes no longer infer feature layout heuristically
lockstep validation passes against the dag-ml integration tip
blockers.missing_contract: Legacy by-source pipelines reassemble source dictionaries and preprocessed blocks in a layout that the current native lowering approximates but does not reproduce within parity tolerance.
blockers.next_owner_action: Finish W53, then let W54 consume the exact layout contract in nirs4all.

blockers.title: Studio compute routes preserve runtime provenance and fallback diagnostics
expected_evidence: route retries preserve requested engine, actual engine, fallback status, and RtError metadata
remaining compute paths are runtime-backed or listed as explicit blockers
bypass parity tests fail if legacy is called silently
blockers.missing_contract: Studio still needs a route-bypass parity gate that prevents UI/backend paths from dropping runtime provenance while dag-ml is selected.
blockers.next_owner_action: Finish W55 and keep route tests in the cutover gate.

blockers.title: Web runtime exposes no-fallback behavior and smoke coverage
expected_evidence: allowFallback=false is observable in browser/runtime errors
single-file build carries runtime metadata
served smoke covers fallback diagnostics
blockers.missing_contract: Web still needs an adoption gate proving runtime metadata survives build and smoke paths, not only unit-level runtime fallback tests.
blockers.next_owner_action: Finish W56 and keep the smoke command in strict cutover validation.

blockers.title: Standalone toolbox can lower or preserve legacy outputs safely
expected_evidence: legacy artifacts are never migrated in place
strict conversions refuse unsafe data before output
native result sidecars are either semantically lowered or preserved with checksums
blockers.missing_contract: W49 lowered prediction arrays to runtime-readable Parquet sidecars; semantic lowering for newer native result metadata still needs a preview path and refusal contract.
blockers.next_owner_action: Finish W59 and update the toolbox smoke if the preview command becomes canonical.

blockers.title: Aggregation release lock matches member contract artifacts
expected_evidence: aggregation-manifest.n4a.json validates
aggregation-lock.n4a.lock.json agrees with current member artifacts
blockers.missing_contract: None for the current lock runner; rerun after integrating W51-W59 because member contract artifacts may change.
blockers.next_owner_action: Refresh the release lock only after final integration branches are selected.

blockers.title: Final default engine flip is isolated to the release commit
expected_evidence: pre-flip this gate fails because DEFAULT_ENGINE is not dag-ml
post-flip this gate passes in the same strict run as every other required gate
blockers.missing_contract: No code contract is missing; this is an intentional final release action after all other blockers are closed.
blockers.next_owner_action: Flip DEFAULT_ENGINE only in the final cutover commit, never as part of an exploratory branch.

blockers.title: Providers expose real-service read adapters without write coupling
command: PYTHONPATH=src pytest -q && ruff check src tests
expected_evidence: repository and benchmarks adapters can read/list/get pipelines without write coupling
tests prove read-only boundaries and service failure behavior
blockers.missing_contract: The provider bridge must keep repository, benchmarks, and future plugin services read-oriented until upload/write APIs are explicitly designed.
blockers.next_owner_action: Finish W57; keep it advisory for DEFAULT_ENGINE cutover but required for broader V1 service release.

blockers.title: Cluster scheduler contract covers DAG rights and result provenance
command: PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q tests/test_distributed_parity.py && ruff check nirs4all_cluster tests/test_distributed_parity.py
expected_evidence: server can schedule DAG-shaped jobs to registered clients with rights metadata
client-submitted jobs preserve runtime/result provenance
distributed parity tests cover the scheduler contract
blockers.missing_contract: Cluster needs a scheduler-level rights/result contract aligned with the nirs4all DAG runtime rather than only local client parity.
blockers.next_owner_action: Finish W58; promote to a strict release gate when cluster is included in the V1 artifact set.
